nodes.name: Schedule Trigger (DEACTIVATED)
nodes.notes: DEACTIVATED. Every 15 min. The brain of the AI Sales Agent. Per client-with-agent-enabled: pulls pending behavioral_triggers + agent_personalities + agent_schedules + recent agent_actions, builds Claude context, asks Claude (Sonnet 4.5) what to do for each lead, writes to agent_decisions, calls action_executor (C2). Respects quiet hours, daily caps, per-lead-per-week caps. Universal multi-vertical — Claude tunes message via personality.vertical_context.

nodes.name: Claude Decide
nodes.notes: alwaysOutputData covers a node that returns NO data; it does not cover a node that THROWS. Without onError the first 401 from Anthropic aborts the whole execution after the webhook has already answered 202, so the run leaves no decision, no error and no trace anywhere.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ (() => { const ins = $input.item.json; const row = Array.isArray(ins) ? ins[0] : ins; const ctx = $('Parse Decision').item.json; return JSON.stringify({ internal_secret: $env.INTERNAL_EMAIL_SECRET, decision_id: row && row.id, action_type: ctx.action_type, channel: ctx.channel, message: ctx.message, lead_id: ctx.lead_id, client_id: ctx.client_id, trigger_id: ctx.trigger_id }); })() }}

nodes.name: Validate Proof Request
nodes.notes: Fail-closed. Supplies one synthetic trigger inline; writes nothing to behavioral_triggers.

nodes.name: Proof Fan Out
nodes.notes: Bridges the proof entry into the existing Per Trigger loop. No new decision logic.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ ok:true, accepted:true, correlation_id: $('Validate Proof Request').item.json.correlation_id, note:'Read-only decision run started; nothing is sent -- the policy gate governs any action.' }) }}

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ workflow_name: 'CLX-Agent-Decision-Engine', node_name: 'Claude Decide', error_code: 'DECISION_NOT_MADE', error_message: $json.error_reason, severity: 'high', category: 'agent_runtime', input_data: { client_id: $json.client_id, lead_id: $json.lead_id, trigger_id: $json.trigger_id, correlation_id: $json.correlation_id } }) }}

nodes.name: Log Decision Failure
nodes.notes: scan_errors is the error table discovery already uses. Reusing it keeps agent failures visible to the same queries, instead of adding a second error store.

parameters.url: ={{ 'https://zqwatouqmqgkmaslydbr.supabase.co/rest/v1/leads?client_id=eq.' + encodeURIComponent($('Validate Proof Request').item.json.client_id) + ($('Validate Proof Request').item.json.lead_id     ? ('&id=eq.' + encodeURIComponent($('Validate Proof Request').item.json.lead_id))     : '&lead_pool=eq.tenant&order=lead_score.desc.nullslast') + '&limit=1&select=id,company,industry,city,job_title,lead_status,lead_score,priority_level,research_summary,research_angle,likely_business_need,detected_signal,signal_confidence,unsubscribed' }}

nodes.name: Fetch Proof Lead
nodes.notes: A real tenant lead for the proof to reason about. Scoped by client_id, so the proof cannot reach another tenant's data. No lead is still a valid run -- the model is told so rather than being given fiction.

nodes.name: Claude Select Tool
nodes.notes: Stage 1. A failure here means no tool is used; the decision still runs.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ internal_secret: $env.INTERNAL_EMAIL_SECRET, tool_name: $json.tool, tool_input: $json.tool_arguments, client_id: $json._carry.client_id, agent_id: 'decision-engine', product: 'sales_engine', correlation_id: $json._carry.correlation_id }) }}

nodes.name: Call MCP Agent Tools
nodes.notes: The canonical capability path. The engine never calls an underlying provider or workflow endpoint directly -- MCP applies the risk class, the product mapping and the tenant check.
